eval_results.prompt: 我在写一个包含批量删除和筛选的订单管理列表页，编码前帮我过一遍交互防御 SOP。

expectations.text: Executes through all 7 steps in sequential order (Intent -> Task Flow -> IA -> Resilience -> Perceived Perf -> Trade-off -> Output)
expectations.evidence: Verified in interaction-design-sop: Steps 1 through 7 in sequential constraint order.

expectations.text: Classifies view elements strictly into P0 (vital), P1 (secondary), and P2 (progressive disclosure)
expectations.evidence: Verified in interaction-design-sop Step 3: Information Architecture P0/P1/P2 triage.

expectations.text: Fully specifies Empty, Loading, and Error states for the order table
expectations.evidence: Verified in interaction-design-sop Step 4: Resilience & Edge Cases (Empty, Error, Loading states required).

expectations.text: Enforces explicit two-step / typed confirmation for destructive bulk deletion

expectations.text: Includes perceived performance optimizations (skeleton screens, optimistic updates, keyboard shortcuts)
